criteria.requirement: Implement bounded Task.Delay, cancellation deadlines and the selected timer/periodic callback APIs through #736. Distinguish requested completion from root cancellation, preserve disposal/stop/reset/overlap semantics, bound callback accumulation and prohibit timer survival after retirement. No sleeping native worker for a guest timer.
